app[content][about]:
[p][b]HUNKER BUNKER[/b] is a retro-futuristic tactical survival game about leading
[/p][p]a squad through a shifting underground bunker, scavenging salvage, and keeping
[/p][p]the lights on when the dark starts moving back.
[/p][p]
[/p][p]You command three specialist operators:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Scout[/b] for fast recon and wide salvage coverage.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tank[/b] for heavy defense and frontline survival.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engineer[/b] for rerouting systems, terminal work, and tactical utility.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Every run pushes you deeper into procedural bunker corridors, hostile biomes, and broken infrastructure. 
[/p][p]Manage oxygen, recover resources, repair critical systems, and decide which threats are worth fighting when supplies run thin.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/eng.intro"][/img]
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Features[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Procedurally generated bunker runs with shifting layouts and escalating pressure.
[/p][/*][*][p]Distinct operator classes with different movement, abilities, and combat roles.
[/p][/*][*][p]Oxygen and salvage management that rewards careful route planning.
[/p][/*][*][p]Discoverable terminals, lore logs, codex entries, camps, and faction secrets.
[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple endings that reflect the choices and survival of your crew.
[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard/mouse support, touch-friendly UI, and remappable controls.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Some secrets in Hunker Bunker are not hidden behind keys. 
[/p][p][b]They are hidden behind the cost of surviving long enough to ask the right questions[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/scout.intro"][/img]
[/p]
app[content][short_description]: Guide your squad of operators through a dark, grid-based cybernetic bunker. Manage oxygen, fortify defenses against mutating cyber-snails, and uncover the lore of the deep biomes in this high-tension tactical survival game.
app[content][sysreqs][windows][min][proc: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
app[content][sysreqs][windows][min][note: Requires a modern GPU that can run Chromium/WebGL reliably.
app[content][sysreqs][linux][min][notes]: Steam Deck is the primary Linux target.
